raw_response_text:
{
  "project_id": "P-STP-YouthEmployment",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "High dependence on Official Development Assistance and low domestic revenue mobilization create fiscal volatility that could impact project sustainability.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Utilize grant-based IDA financing for full project funding and lock in multi-year resource commitments within the Project Operations Manual.",
      "evidence": "Persistently low domestic revenue mobilization has kept STP heavily dependent on Official Development Assistance (ODA), leaving fiscal revenues highly volatile."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Recurrent extreme climate events such as floods and coastal storms may damage infrastructure, disrupt electricity, and delay service delivery.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Adopt climate-resilient EDGE design standards for center construction, procure backup power generators, and include a Contingent Emergency Response Component (CERC).",
      "evidence": "STP is vulnerable to coastal and riparian floods, severe storms... may cause disruptions in service delivery, potentially leading to short delays."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Cross-ministerial coordination complexities across MLSSS, MECSHE, MEYST, and MAFRD may cause delays in annual workplan preparation and execution.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Establish a Strategic Coordination Committee under the Minister of Labor and formalize inter-institutional roles in the Project Operations Manual.",
      "evidence": "delays in preparing annual workplans and implementing interventions due to the involvement of multiple stakeholders"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Fiduciary management bottlenecks within AFAP, including delayed transaction recording and internal audit backlogs, could hinder project implementation.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Designate a dedicated project accountant, customize the financial accounting software, and expand external audit scope within six months of effectiveness.",
      "evidence": "delays in recording financial transactions... internal audit reviews not conducted in a timely manner, leading to identification of weak controls"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Non-compliance with selection criteria or payment processing issues could delay grant and stipend disbursements to vulnerable youth and MSMEs.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Define objective eligibility criteria in the POM, leverage the Unique Social Registry, and execute direct transfers via a contracted electronic Payment Service Provider.",
      "evidence": "delays in availing funds for beneficiaries resulting from possible non-compliance in selection criteria."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Social exclusion or elite capture in selecting beneficiaries for scholarships, sub-grants, and internships could prevent marginalized youth from participating.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Use objective socio-economic data from the Unique Social Registry, mandate a minimum 50% quota for women, and maintain an active Grievance Redress Mechanism.",
      "evidence": "risks of exclusion, which may arise if project benefits are not equitably distributed... risks of elite capture in the selection of beneficiaries"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Risks of sexual exploitation, abuse, and sexual harassment (SEA/SH) during training sessions or employer workplace placements, particularly affecting young women.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Hire a dedicated Social/GBV Specialist within 45 days of effectiveness, integrate SEA/SH prevention codes into institutional agreements, and establish confidential reporting channels.",
      "evidence": "community health and safety risks, including risks of sexual exploitation and abuse (SEA) and sexual harassment (SH), particularly for young women"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Sub-grants to micro-enterprises in agriculture, fisheries, or tourism might cause localized environmental degradation or pollution if improperly managed.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Require environmental risk screening for all sub-grant proposals and train business incubators and MSMEs on ESG standards and sustainable practices.",
      "evidence": "small business grants could support micro-enterprises... that may indirectly place pressure on sensitive ecosystems or cause localized pollution"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Geographic isolation, transport constraints, and high material supply costs on Príncipe Island could cause construction cost overruns and timeline delays for the new training center.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Conduct early site-specific engineering assessments, centralize procurement through AFAP, and build realistic cost buffers into the procurement plan.",
      "evidence": "Príncipe—home to just about 10,000 people—is more than 170 km away and experiences compounded isolation."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Existing public TVET institutions suffer from outdated equipment, staff gaps, and weak industry linkages, threatening training quality.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Provide direct financing for modern equipment procurement, instructor upskilling, and establish Workforce Development Committees with private sector employers.",
      "evidence": "capacity remains constrained by outdated equipment, limited infrastructure, insufficient operating budgets, staffing gaps, and weak employer participation"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Weak institutional capacity and fragmented existing tools at DTEFP could impede the operationalization of the new labor market information system.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Recruit specialized technical consultants, provide targeted staff training, and modernize DTEFP office equipment and cloud-based architecture.",
      "evidence": "Services for labor intermediation... remain at an early stage of development... tools and processes... are currently fragmented, underutilized, and poorly interconnected."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Delays in hiring key environmental, social, TVET, and IT specialists within legal covenants timelines could stall initial project implementation.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Initiate early drafting of terms of reference and leverage the existing restructured SPRRP Project Implementation Unit team to maintain momentum.",
      "evidence": "hire or appoint, not later than forty-five (45) days after Effectiveness: (i) one Environmental Specialist... (ii) one Social Specialist"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "STP's small, highly informal private sector may lack sufficient absorption capacity to hire trained youth in wage employment.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Combine wage employment support with self-employment starter packages, MSME productivity growth grants, and labor mobility orientation.",
      "evidence": "Micro and small enterprises make up 92 percent of all firms... Most are household-run and provide few job opportunities."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "High desire among youth to emigrate may result in skilled graduate flight without yielding economic returns to the local domestic economy.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Integrate structured labor mobility frameworks (such as Global Skill Partnerships) and pre-departure guidance to maximize remittance flows and formal overseas placement.",
      "evidence": "68 percent of youth are considering leaving the country in search of better opportunities abroad... emigration has yielded limited economic benefits"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "Unreliable power supply and grid failures could disrupt digital operations, cloud databases, and the online Employability Portal.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Procure backup power generators for DTEFP and deploy cloud-based software architectures with offline-capable data synchronization capabilities.",
      "evidence": "Structural constraints such as costly and unreliable electricity... intense rainfall and floods which may disrupt electricity access"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R16",
      "description": "Interagency bottlenecks between technical teams at MLSSS and fiduciary specialists at AFAP could slow contract drafting and evaluation processes.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Establish clear procurement workflows in the Project Operations Manual and mandate joint bi-weekly progress reviews between MLSSS and AFAP.",
      "evidence": "A key factor for good procurement performance will be the ability of AFAP and the MLSSS to work in close collaboration"
    }
  ]
}
